shiftRequests.description: People ask for a shift they forgot to clock, or for new times. Times in {{timeZone}}.

empty.pending: No requests are waiting for a decision.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Purchase invoices by issue date. Click one for its details.
expenses.descriptionKsef: Purchase invoices by issue date, imported from KSeF or entered by hand. Click one for its details.
expenses.noneMatching: No expenses match the filters in this period.

sheet.importedFrom: Imported from {{source}}: only the category can be changed.

error.issueDate: Choose the date on the document.

error.businessDate: Choose the day the daily report covers.
error.futureDate: The day can't be after today.

income.description: Each register's daily report, by the day it covers. Click an amount to correct it.

noRegister.title: Add a register first
noRegister.description: Income is entered per register, one daily report each. Add the tills with their own fiscal printer, then come back to enter what they took.

days.none_month: No days to enter in {{period}} yet.
days.allEntered: Every day so far has at least one entry.

days.missing_other: {{count}} days have no entry yet. An empty cell adds that register's day.

vat.none: No entry has a VAT breakdown.

vat.grossLess: The VAT gross is {{amount}} less than the payments. Allowed: e.g. invoiced transfers aren't on the fiscal reports.

entry.fixed: The register and the day don't change: delete the entry and add it again.
entry.deletedMeanwhile: That entry was deleted in the meantime. Try saving again.
entry.paymentsDescription: Gross amounts. Leave a method empty if it wasn't used; 0 is fine.
entry.vatBreakdownDescription: As printed on the register's daily report. You can also add it later.
entry.vatMore: The VAT breakdown is {{amount}} more than the payments. That's allowed, e.g. for a transfer that isn't on the fiscal report.
entry.vatLess: The VAT breakdown is {{amount}} less than the payments. That's allowed, e.g. for a transfer that isn't on the fiscal report.
entry.notePlaceholder: Optional, e.g. an invoiced event paid by transfer
entry.deleteDescription: {{amount}} leaves the month's totals. A deleted entry can't be restored; you can enter the day again.
entry.noPaymentMethods: The organization has no active payment method.
entry.deactivatedMethod: Deactivated: this entry keeps it, but new entries can't use it.
entry.bookedFromClose: Booked from the end-of-day close: the register and the day don't change, and the payments change only when the close is corrected. You can add the VAT breakdown and a note.
entry.bookedPaymentsDescription: From the end-of-day close: cash is the change in the cash storages, the other methods as entered at the close.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.description: Gross pay for a month from the ended shifts and each person's rate. Your accountant does the rest.
payroll.readyOwner: Review the paychecks, then approve. Approving locks the month's shifts and rates.
payroll.readyManager: Review the paychecks. An owner approves the run, which locks the month's shifts and rates.

noRun.thisMonth: This month isn't over. A draft now is a preview: it can be approved once the month has ended.
noRun.pastMonth: Generate a draft from the month's ended shifts and the rates, review it, then an owner approves it.

run.locked: The month's shifts and rates are locked.

toast.reopen: {{period}} reopened as a draft: its shifts are unlocked

confirm.approveDescription_one: {{amount}} gross in {{count}} paycheck. The month's shifts and rates are locked until the run is reopened.
confirm.approveDescription_other: {{amount}} gross in {{count}} paychecks. The month's shifts and rates are locked until the run is reopened.
confirm.reopenDescription: The run goes back to a draft and the month's shifts and rates are unlocked. It has to be approved again.
confirm.deleteDescription: Its paychecks and adjustments are deleted. You can generate the month again.

paychecks.title: Paychecks
paychecks.draft: Click a person to see their shifts and adjustments.
paychecks.markEach: Mark each paycheck paid once the money has left.

lines.roundedMore: Pay for hours is rounded once from the exact time, so it is {{amount}} more than the sum of the shift amounts.
lines.roundedLess: Pay for hours is rounded once from the exact time, so it is {{amount}} less than the sum of the shift amounts.

generate.generateDescription: One paycheck per person with ended shifts this month, one line per shift, at each shift's rate.
generate.regenerateDescription: Rebuilds the paychecks from the current shifts and rates. Adjustments stay.
generate.exact: Shifts are paid to the second.
generate.nearest: To the nearest rounds a half up.

payment.title: Mark paid: {{name}}
payment.description: {{amount}} gross for {{period}}. Once a paycheck is marked paid, the run can't be reopened.
payment.undoFailed: Could not undo the paid mark

paidBy.cash: Paid on {{date}} by cash, marked on {{marked}}.
paidBy.transfer: Paid on {{date}} by transfer, marked on {{marked}}.

adjustment.description: A bonus adds to the month's pay; an advance already paid takes off it. Adjustments stay when the run is regenerated.
adjustment.label: What for
adjustment.amountDescription: Gross. Use a minus for a deduction, e.g. −200.

toast.description: {{name}}: {{amount}} per hour. Regenerate drafts to use it.

rate.hourlyDescription: The usual gross rate per hour from a date until the next rate. Earlier shifts keep the earlier rate.
rate.dayDescription: A different gross rate per hour for the shifts that start on one date, such as New Year's Eve.
rate.lockedDates: Dates in an approved payroll month can't change.

rates.title: Rates
rates.description: Gross pay per hour. A raise is a new rate from a date; earlier shifts keep the earlier rate. A day rate replaces it for the shifts that start on one date.
rates.everyoneHasRate: Everyone has a rate today. Click a person to see their history and day rates.
rates.withoutRate_one: {{count}} person has no rate today: their shifts can't be paid until one is set.
rates.withoutRate_other: {{count}} people have no rate today: their shifts can't be paid until one is set.
rates.deleteDayDescription: {{name}}'s shifts on {{date}} go back to the hourly rate.
rates.deleteHourlyDescription: {{name}}'s shifts from {{date}} go back to the previous rate, or to none.
rates.lockedTitle: In an approved payroll month: reopen the run to change it
rates.locked: Locked by an approved payroll month

team.description: People with access to this organization.

ownRoleTitle.owner: Change your own role to owner?

totals.description_month: Time worked in {{period}}. An open shift counts once it is clocked out.
totals.none: Nobody worked a shift in this period.

shifts.description: Newest first. Open shifts are highlighted; end a forgotten one with End shift.

shiftDialog.editDescription: {{name}}, {{date}}. The shift keeps who changed it and when.

shiftDialog.keepOpen: Leave empty to keep the shift open.

settings.description: Used across all modules: invoices, payroll and reports.
settings.name: Business name
settings.taxIdDescription: Needed to fetch purchase invoices from KSeF.
settings.csvDescription: Pick what your spreadsheet expects, e.g. for the payroll export. Excel in Polish or German uses semicolons.

dayCloses.title: End-of-day closes
dayCloses.description: The cash counted at the end of each day, with what the storages were expected to hold. A close books the day's revenue entry.
dayCloses.shortageDescription: The storages hold less cash than expected: a mistake in the count, or cash taken out that nobody recorded. The cash line of the revenue entry is booked as 0.
dayCloses.unknownMethod: A payment method no longer offered

list.none: No day was closed in this period. Employees close the day in the time clock, or you can record a close here.

detail.title: Close of {{date}}
detail.bookedAsCash: Booked as cash in the revenue entry: {{amount}}.
detail.noNonCash: No non-cash payment method was active at the close.
detail.revenueEntryOf: Booked for {{register}}, with the cash and the non-cash payments.
detail.noRevenueEntry: No revenue entry is booked from this close. Correct the close and save it to book it again.

editor.dateHint: Any day up to today, after the last closed day.
editor.dateUpToToday: Pick a day up to today.
editor.registerHint: The register whose revenue entry the close books.
editor.countedHint: What stays in it after the close, every denomination. An empty field is zero.
editor.depositHint: Only what was put into it at the close. An empty field is zero.
editor.nonCashHint: The day's amount for each method, as the terminal or the report shows it. An empty field is zero.
editor.shortage: {{amount}} short: the close will be flagged, and its cash booked as 0.
editor.fixFields: Some fields hold something that is not a number of pieces or an amount. Fix them to save.

correct.title: Correct the close of {{date}}
correct.description: Change the counts, the deposits, the non-cash amounts or the register. The day doesn't change: to close another day, delete this close and record a new one.
correct.confirmIncome: The cash income goes from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{booked}} booked as cash).
correct.confirmDescription: The revenue entry booked from the close follows, and so does the next close of each counted storage.

delete.title: Delete the close of {{date}}?
delete.description: Its revenue entry is deleted too, with its VAT breakdown and note. The cash it counted then counts in the next close of each storage, which is computed again. This can't be undone.
delete.failed: The close could not be deleted

recordPage.title: Record an end-of-day close
recordPage.description: Count every counted storage, enter what went into each deposit storage and the day's non-cash amounts, as an employee would in the time clock.
recordPage.cannotClose: There is nothing to close yet: the organization needs an active cash storage, a denomination of its currency and an active register.

cashFlow.title: Cash flow
cashFlow.description: What each storage holds now, and every movement and close that changed it.

balances.title: Balances
balances.none: There are no cash storages yet: add one first.
balances.estimateHint: An estimate until the next close: the day's takings are counted then.
balances.negativeEstimate: Below zero: cash taken out since the last count, which the next close replaces.
balances.retiredHint: Still holds deactivated denominations ({{denominations}}). Take them out with an adjustment.

history.description: Movements and end-of-day closes, newest first, in the organization's time zone.
history.ofStorage: Movements and closes of “{{name}}”, newest first.

description.transfer: The same pieces leave one storage and go into another. It changes no income.
description.count: What a deposit storage holds, counted outside a close. It replaces the balance; the difference is shown as the discrepancy.

form.sameStorage: The cash must go into another storage.
form.deactivatedStorage: This storage is deactivated: cash can only be taken out of it.
form.countOnlyDeposit: Only deposit storages are audited: counted ones are counted at each close.
form.noDenominations: There are no active denominations. Add them in Denominations first.
form.fixPieces: Enter whole numbers of pieces, from 0 to 1,000,000.
form.noteTooLong_one: A note can have at most {{count}} character.
form.noteTooLong_other: A note can have at most {{count}} characters.
form.whenHint: In the organization's time zone ({{timeZone}}). Not later than now.
form.momentInvalid: Enter a date and a time.
form.momentSkipped: {{time}} doesn't exist on this day (the clocks go forward). Pick another time.
form.momentInFuture: This is later than now: pick an earlier time.

delete.changesClose_other: The closes of {{dates}} are recalculated: their expected openings, cash income and the cash booked in their revenue entries.

cashStorages.description: Where the cash is kept. Each one is part of every end-of-day close: counted, or taking deposits.
cashStorages.noneActive: No active storages. Add one before the first end-of-day close.
cashStorages.deactivatedDescription: They are not part of new closes. Past closes and movements keep them, under their names.

modeDescription.counted: At the close, every denomination in it is counted, and the count is its new balance (e.g. the cash box).
modeDescription.deposit: At the close, the employee enters only what they put in, without knowing the balance (e.g. a drop safe).

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.description: No close or movement refers to it, so nothing else changes. The name becomes free again.

error.nameTakenByDeactivated: A deactivated storage is already named “{{name}}”. Reactivate it, or pick another name.

dialog.editDescription: Past closes and movements show the new name.
dialog.addDescription: A cash box, a safe or another place cash is kept. It starts empty: record its opening float as an adjustment.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.modeChangeHint: The change applies from the next close.
dialog.nameDescription_one: Up to {{count}} character, different from your other storages.
dialog.nameDescription_other: Up to {{count}} characters, different from your other storages.

denominations.noneActive: No active denominations in {{currency}}. Add the coins and notes you count.
denominations.deactivatedDescription: They are not counted any more. If a storage still holds some, take them out with an adjustment.

error.valueRequired: Enter a value greater than zero.
